components.network and neighborhood: Network preserves registered processes and directed communication rows. exactNeighborhood proves computed membership iff a retained registered trace reaches the process within the stated radius; neighborhoodHeld excludes unsupported result identities.
components.trace and composition: Reach.identity/next retains every communication row; traceEndpoints,traceRows,serial and traceExtension prove endpoints,source rows,serial composition and successor preservation.
components.local inputs and lower witness: viewRow/viewProvenance retain process identity and actual local input observation. indistinguishableOutput/lowerWitness prove the observation-relative output boundary for locally identical instances with incompatible required outputs.
components.boundary: queryBoundary rejects a process outside the registered carrier. omittedRowRejected excludes any trace that uses an unregistered channel row. Radius is the trace length bound, not a fitted scientific parameter.
components.grammar and controls: Complete original256 candidates,three witnesses,four controls,every source program field/hash and unknown-ID rejection match pinned V3.
